_comment: Power Automate flow template — ClaimSphere Escalation → Teams Notification
_instructions: 1. In Power Automate, create a new Instant cloud flow
2. Add trigger: 'When an HTTP request is received' (generates the webhook URL)
3. Copy the generated URL into POWER_AUTOMATE_WEBHOOK_URL in your .env / GitHub secret
4. Add action: 'Parse JSON' with the schema below
5. Add action: 'Post adaptive card in a chat or channel' (Teams connector)
- Adaptive Card: use the parsed 'adaptive_card' field from step 4
6. Save and test by submitting a claim that triggers escalation

trigger.description: Receives escalation payload from ClaimSphere backend

actions.name: Notify Claims Review Channel
actions.description: Posts the Adaptive Card with Approve / Reject / More Info action buttons

callback_flow._comment: Optional second flow — triggered when adjudicator clicks a Teams card button
callback_flow._description: The Adaptive Card Action.Http buttons POST directly to /webhooks/teams-decision on the ClaimSphere backend. No additional PA flow needed for the callback — the backend handles it directly.
